observation.visible_scene: A static, very low-angle ground-level view of an outdoor paved path. The foreground is out-of-focus grey asphalt with a tiny blue speck resting on it; behind it runs a lighter paved strip, then a stone balustrade pierced by a row of round holes, and blurred green foliage beyond. Within the frame a jogger wearing bright neon-yellow/green running shoes and white socks, together with cyclists (one rider's bare feet in dark sandals on pedals are clearly visible), pass through the scene. The moving subjects are heavily motion-blurred, while the background structure stays sharp and fixed.
visible_changes: At the start the jogger's neon shoe is mid-stride near the centre and a blue-framed bicycle with a sandalled rider is behind it; the shoe then rises and travels rightward, planting on the ground at the right side before leaving the frame on the right around the 0.33-0.40 s marks.

A second bicycle (grey frame, rider pedalling in sandals) enters from the left edge around 0.13 s and moves steadily rightward across the frame, its wheels and sandalled feet crossing the centre and finally exiting at the right edge around 0.87-0.93 s.
The blue bicycle in the background likewise shifts rightward and disappears off the right edge early in the segment.

From about 1.0 s to 2.6 s the path is empty of any subject: only the static road, balustrade and trees are seen, with the small blue speck on the asphalt holding the same position throughout (indicating the camera is not panning).
In the final frame a bicycle wheel begins to intrude at the left edge, marking the start of a new crossing.
Throughout, the subjects' movement is left-to-right relative to a fixed background; the blur on the legs and wheels reflects their motion, not camera motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: The state of the scene before the first frame (the jogger and cyclists were already in motion when the crop begins).
What happens after the last frame (the wheel entering at the left presumably continues crossing, but its completion is not shown).
The total number of riders and whether the sandalled feet belong to one or more cyclists outside this window.
The jogger's upper body and the cyclists' full figures, which are mostly cropped out of the low framing.
uncertain_details: Exact stride phase of the jogger (only one foot is in view at a time).
Whether the blue-framed bike and the grey-framed sandalled bike are distinct riders or the same one re-entering; positions suggest two separate bicycles moving right at different times.
Minor apparent jitter of the background between frames is too small to confirm any camera movement; the fixed blue speck argues the camera is essentially static.
